title: DUALVIEW: Leveraging Broad and Output-Specific Evidence for LLM-based Multi-Output Text Regression
abstract: arXiv:2610.19206v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While work on LLM-based regression has largely focused on scalar prediction, multi-output text regression remains less explored. We present DualView, a parameter-efficient approach to leverage LLMs for multi-output text regression. \method{} first extracts broad and output-specific representations from a frozen LLM, then uses a dual-branch architecture to produce the full score vector. Across five heterogeneous regression tasks and eight LLMs (up to 122B), DualView outperforms seven supervised regression baselines while requiring 82--1842 times fewer fitted parameters than the three strongest baselines. These improvements extend across individual output dimensions and persist even with limited training data. Notably, DualView using a smaller open-weight LLM can outperform unsupervised prediction with Gemini 3.1 Pro. translated_title: DUALVIEW：利用广泛证据与输出特定证据进行基于大语言模型的多输出文本回归
translated_abstract: 尽管基于大语言模型（LLM）的回归研究主要集中于标量预测，但多输出文本回归仍然鲜有探索。我们提出了DualView，一种利用大语言模型进行多输出文本回归的参数高效方法。DualView首先从冻结的大语言模型中提取广泛表征和输出特定表征，然后采用双分支架构生成完整的分数向量。在五个异构回归任务和八个大语言模型（最大至122B参数）上的实验表明，DualView优于七个监督回归基线，同时其所需拟合参数比三个最强基线少82至1842倍。这些改进延伸至各个单独的输出维度，并且在训练数据有限的情况下依然保持。值得注意的是，使用较小开源权重大语言模型的DualView甚至可以超越使用Gemini 3.1 Pro的无监督预测。受控消融实验表明，广泛证据与输出特定证据能够提供互补的预测收益，同时轻量级的……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: DualView是一种参数高效的双分支方法，通过从冻结的大语言模型中提取广泛表征和输出特定表征来实现多输出文本回归，在五个任务上以远少于基线的参数量超越了监督回归方法，甚至可超越更大模型的无监督预测。
en_tdlr: DualView is a parameter-efficient dual-branch approach that leverages both broad and output-specific evidence extracted from frozen LLMs for multi-output text regression, outperforming supervised baselines across five tasks with 82–1842× fewer fitted parameters, even surpassing unsupervised prediction with larger models like Gemini 3.1 Pro.
